repos_data.description: The fastest automatic differentiation library for C++, with Python bindings. Forward, adjoint and higher-order derivatives, checkpointing, Eigen support and JIT. Reproducible benchmarks against CppAD, Adept and autodiff.

Implement, demonstrate, reproduce and extend the results of the Risk articles 'Differential Machine Learning' (2020) and 'PCA with a Difference' (2021) by Huge and Savine, and cover implementation details left out from the papers.
